topic: Woolly rhinos of the Ice Age
script: Woolly rhinos roamed Ice Age Europe and Asia alongside mammoths. Their front horn could grow over 1 meter long. Thick fur and a layer of fat kept them warm on frozen grasslands. Early humans painted them on cave walls more than 30,000 years ago. Frozen woolly rhinos have been found in the Siberian permafrost. They died out around 14,000 years ago.
